mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 1%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5, or the Rank IC for UNRATE is < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 return over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 days as the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy to combat inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL is < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days. This effect is consistent across all levels of PAYEMS.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20d SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between PAYEMS and 20d SPX returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.5, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates a severe demand contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 days as corporate earnings are pressured by weak consumer demand.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0, or the Rank IC for UNRATE is < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
